# ANI Medical Encyclopedia

> ANI is a public nursing-focused medical encyclopedia with structured disease, medication, laboratory, procedure, clinical-reference, microbiology, and holistic-remedy content.

## Public content

- [ANI home](https://aniapp.ai/): Search and browse the encyclopedia.
- [Encyclopedia topic index](https://aniapp.ai/encyclopedia/): Browse 4817 public topics.
- [Public topic discovery index](https://aniapp.ai/encyclopedia/search-index.json): Discover topics by canonical title, authored alias or abbreviation, runtime search term, category, subcategory, collection, and type without JavaScript.
- [XML sitemap](https://aniapp.ai/sitemap.xml): Discover every public topic URL.
- [Medical Updates](https://aniapp.ai/data/medical-updates.json): Public official-publication update feed.

## Content-use signals

Public search indexing and real-time AI retrieval are allowed. AI model training is not permitted. See robots.txt for protected paths and crawler directives.

## Safety

ANI is educational and does not replace patient-specific assessment, diagnosis, prescribing, emergency evaluation, or current local clinical guidance.
